items.title: A new look, and insights for every thread and board
items.body:
CommentGrab has a new design and a new logo, with a dark mode that follows your system setting.

- Each saved thread now has a Comments tab and an Insights tab.
- Analyze a whole board, or a batch of posts, as one combined report.
- Before anything goes to OpenAI you see the model, the comments sent and an estimated cost, and you can turn the check off in Settings.
- The capture widget has a close button and stays hidden while a video plays fullscreen.
- News and release notes now show up here, under What's new.

items.title: CommentGrab 1.1: Reddit batches
items.body:
- Reddit batches. From any Reddit search or subreddit page, scrape the top posts in one pass, ranked by comment count and pulled straight from the results you actually see.
- Bulk analyze and export. Tick the posts you want, then run AI analysis across all of them or export the whole set to one CSV, JSON or Markdown file.
- Already-scraped posts are skipped by default, so a batch never re-pulls threads that are in your library.
- AI ad angles now surface as many distinct angles as the comments support. The old cap is gone.

items.title: CommentGrab is live
items.body:
- One-click export of public comments and reviews to CSV, JSON or Markdown. Free, source-available and entirely local.
- A floating capture widget on every supported page, with live scrape progress and inline export.
- AI analysis with your own OpenAI key: objections, hooks, emotional triggers, verbatim customer language, themes and sentiment.
- A dashboard with saved collections, scrape history and on-device stats.
